tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: The BenchLeader Index leaderboard of large language models: a daily composite of independent public benchmarks, one row per model (its best reasoning-effort configuration) as on the homepage. Optionally rank by one category score (coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge…), list every model × eff

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find models by name, alias, id or developer ("opus", "gemini 4", "deepseek"). Returns each match's id, rank, Index and reasoning-effort configurations, for use with get_model and compare_models.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model's BenchLeader profile: Index and rank, category scores, list price, speed, latency, context window, its other reasoning-effort configurations, and its strongest independent benchmark results (each with its board rank, publisher and source link).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Head-to-head comparison of two models with BenchLeader's verdict: who leads on quality (a lead is claimed only outside the combined margin of error), price and speed ratios, category-by-category wins, when to choose each, and shared benchmark results. Links the comparison page.

tools.name: list_benchmarks
tools.description: The benchmarks BenchLeader reads: what each measures, publisher, category, whether it feeds the Index (and its weight), how many models it covers, status and caveats. Filter by category or a search query. Paged.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: One benchmark: what it measures, unit, publisher and source, whether and how much it counts in the BenchLeader Index, status and caveats, and its top models (one row per model, best result first).

tools.name: about_benchleader
tools.description: What BenchLeader is, how the BenchLeader Index is computed, the current method version, data date and update cadence, coverage counts, licence and how to cite it.
